name: Clear Condition
Effect? (human readable): reduces the amuont of a specific debuff

name: Defense
Effect? (human readable): replaces X with the passed in amount

name: DR
Param (human readable): temp hp / duration before they are removed
Effect? (human readable): gain a number of temp hp. After the duration remove any remaining temp hp.

name: Enfeeble
Effect? (human readable): apply the enfeeble condition (not set yet. probably reduce damage to a minimum of 1)

name: Heal
Param (human readable): amount – can be a static number or enum
Effect? (human readable): replaces X with the passed in amount

name: Milk
Param (human readable): optional: how many of each debuff gets cleared. If blank will default to -1 to clear all
Effect? (human readable): remove all basic? Negative status conditions. This will likely be a set list with ‘most’ conditions on it to leave a few that are supposed to be extra dangerous/lenghty

name: Skill
Param (human readable): required: skill name / how much up or down the scale it moves.

name: Slow
Effect? (human readable): apply the slow condition

name: Wait
Param (human readable): how long to wait until the effect happens
Effect? (human readable): delays everything after it in the effect list

name: Add Ability
Effect? (human readable): bounded list of abilities that can be added. Additional file that extends add_ability with its own seperate list of params

name: Ignore Terrain Slowdown
Param (human readable): what type of terrain should be ignored.
Effect? (human readable): not limited to the overall terrain. probably just checks the tags on the square and the overall map. So it could also check for rock and only rocks get ignored. This will not allow the character to bypass impassable terrain.

name: Use Card
Effect? (human readable): uses the card once per square targeted with the target being that square.

name: Stat Mod
Effect? (human readable): raise or lower a specific stat. This is not meant to be a status effect but for effects that permanently change the ‘stat’ while worn. This is not actually limited to just the stats. It is a bound list.

name: Destroy Item
Effect? (human readable): destroyed the selected item. The first need for this was an item destroying itself, but is meant to be expanded as needed.

name: Coin
Param (human readable): amount – can be a static number or enum / optional: static value
Effect? (human readable): replaces X with the passed in amount

name: Harm
Param (human readable): amount – can be a static number or enum / optional: static value
Effect? (human readable): replaces X with the passed in amount and then reduce the current hp by that amount
